reuse.why: Takes its category set from the existing getBulkBudgetCategories used by setBulkAverage and uses getSheetValue/batchMessages, but re-writes the income/tracking guard and the expense sign flip inline.

duplication.why: The `is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()` skip and the `is_income ? x : -x` conversion repeat logic already written in setBulkAverage/setZero and setNMonthAvg.

placement.why: The action lives in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts the same way.

scope.why: Only the action, its registration and a test are added.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with neighbouring actions; a change to the income guard or sign rule would still need editing in several actions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getBulkBudgetCategories; no shared helper for the income guard or sign exists to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated income guard and sign flip are plain inline copies of the tree's pattern, not disguised.
